body:
Bumps [serialize-javascript](https://github.com/yahoo/serialize-javascript) to 7.1.2 and updates ancestor dependency [mocha](https://github.com/mochajs/mocha). These dependencies need to be updated together. Updates `serialize-javascript` from 6.0.2 to 7.1.2
Release notes

Sourced from serialize-javascript's releases.

v7.1.2

See: https://github.com/yahoo/serialize-javascript/security/advisories/GHSA-gfhx-hw2g-v5hg

v7.1.1

What's Changed

  • fix: fix XSS bypass via split </script payload across function bodies by @​okuryu in yahoo/serialize-javascript#226
  • release: v7.1.1 by @​okuryu in yahoo/serialize-javascript#227

Full Changelog: https://github.com/yahoo/serialize-javascript/compare/v7.1.0...v7.1.1

v7.1.0

What's Changed

  • feat: add Node.js 26 to test matrix by @​okuryu in yahoo/serialize-javascript#224
  • release: v7.1.0 by @​okuryu in yahoo/serialize-javascript#225

Full Changelog: https://github.com/yahoo/serialize-javascript/compare/v7.0.7...v7.1.0

v7.0.7

What's Changed

  • fix: reject spoofed RegExp objects with non-string source property by @​redonkulus in yahoo/serialize-javascript#222
  • release: v7.0.7 by @​okuryu in yahoo/serialize-javascript#223

Full Changelog: https://github.com/yahoo/serialize-javascript/compare/v7.0.6...v7.0.7

v7.0.6

What's Changed

  • build(deps-dev): bump lodash from 4.17.23 to 4.18.1 by @​dependabot[bot] in yahoo/serialize-javascript#215
  • fix: reject spoofed URL objects with non-string toString() result by @​redonkulus in yahoo/serialize-javascript#217
  • release: v7.0.6 by @​okuryu in yahoo/serialize-javascript#221

Full Changelog: https://github.com/yahoo/serialize-javascript/compare/v7.0.5...v7.0.6

v7.0.5

Fixes

  • Improve robustness and validation for array-like object serialization.
  • Fix an issue where certain object structures could lead to excessive CPU usage.

For more details, please see GHSA-qj8w-gfj5-8c6v.

v7.0.4

What's Changed

  • release: v7.0.4 by @​okuryu in yahoo/serialize-javascript#211

Full Changelog: https://github.com/yahoo/serialize-javascript/compare/v7.0.3...v7.0.4

... (truncated)

Commits
  • 6a73fa1 release: v7.1.2
  • 2bdbaaf Merge commit from fork
  • 8c8caa7 release: v7.1.1
  • ffda9f1 fix: fix XSS bypass via split </script payload across function bodies
  • 739145a release: v7.1.0
  • 57865ed feat: add Node.js 26 to test matrix
  • 01bec60 release: v7.0.7
  • 5009715 fix: reject spoofed RegExp objects with non-string source property
  • 153eb43 release: v7.0.6
  • a83d2cb fix: reject spoofed URL objects with non-string toString() result
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view
Maintainer changes

This version was pushed to npm by GitHub Actions, a new releaser for serialize-javascript since your current version.

v12.0.3

📚 Documentation

🧹 Chores
